# MM Transports

> Family-run container truck transport company based on Willingdon Island inside the Kochi Port
> area, Kerala, India. Founded 1997. Operates an owned fleet of 15 container trucks across Kerala,
> Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh. Does not broker or subcontract vehicles.

## Key facts

- **Legal/trading name:** MM Transports
- **Founded:** 1997, by Manoharan Nagarajan
- **Operations lead:** M Vishnu Prasad (the founder's son), running day-to-day operations since 2024
- **Ownership:** Family owned and operated, second generation
- **Address:** CDEA Building, Indira Gandhi Road, opposite Fire Station, Willingdon Island, Kochi, Kerala 682003, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 96336 65648
- **Email:** operations@mmtransports.in
- **Working hours:** Monday to Saturday, 9:00 am to 6:30 pm
- **Fleet:** 15 container transport trucks, all company-owned, currently expanding
- **Registration:** GST registered
- **Areas served:** Kerala (all districts), Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh

## What makes MM Transports different

Every truck on a job is owned by the company and every driver is directly employed. Most road
freight booked in the region passes through one or more brokers before a vehicle moves; MM
Transports has never worked that way. Maintenance is done in-house. Being based on Willingdon
Island, inside the Kochi Port area, keeps positioning runs short for port container work.

## Services

- **Container Transport** — enclosed container trucks for packaged, palletised and containerised cargo; sealed at pickup, opened at delivery.
- **Port Container Movement** — container shifting to and from Kochi Port, operated from a base inside the port area.
- **Factory & Industrial Goods Transport** — raw materials inbound and finished goods outbound on fixed schedules for manufacturers.
- **Interstate Long Distance Transport** — Kerala to Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh. Common corridors include Kochi to Coimbatore, Kochi to Tiruppur, and Kochi to Bangalore.
- **Regular Contract Movement** — dedicated trucks on a recurring weekly or monthly schedule at rates fixed in advance.

## Frequently asked questions

**What kind of trucks does MM Transports operate?**
A fleet of 15 container transport trucks, all owned and operated directly by the company rather
than brokered from third parties. The fleet is being expanded.

**Where is MM Transports located?**
CDEA Building, Indira Gandhi Road, opposite the Fire Station, Willingdon Island, Kochi, Kerala
682003 — inside the Kochi Port area.

**Which areas does MM Transports cover?**
Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh.

**Does MM Transports handle container movement to and from Kochi Port?**
Yes. Port container shifting is core work, and the office sits inside the port area on Willingdon
Island.

**How long has MM Transports been in business?**
Since 1997 — close to thirty years of continuous operation.

**Is MM Transports GST registered?**
Yes, with full consignment documentation issued on every load.

**How do I get a quote?**
Call or WhatsApp +91 96336 65648, or use the contact form at https://mmtransports.in/contact.html.
Quotes are returned the same working day.
